snippet.title: "Incline ~Railway of devil's valley~" -Trailer
snippet.description:
Promotional video of sole development indie game "Incline".

■Summary■
Set in a valley village in 1902 Japan, this 3D action ADV explores a village while fighting devils.
It features an eccentric battle system that uses an inclined railway to carry devils to the sacred boundary and seal them off.

[Web] https://gudouan.com/onigadani_E.html
[Steam] https://store.steampowered.com/app/2814940/
[Twitter] https://twitter.com/gudouan
